questions.stem: What is the relative charge of a proton?
questions.explanation: A proton has a relative charge of +1. It is found in the nucleus and is responsible for the positive charge of the nucleus. Electrons have a charge of −1 and neutrons have a charge of 0.

questions.stem: How do you calculate the number of neutrons in an atom?
questions.explanation: The number of neutrons equals the mass number (A) minus the atomic number (Z). The mass number is the total of protons and neutrons, so subtracting the protons (atomic number) gives the neutrons: N = A − Z.
